entries.title: Psalms 135:1
segments: ¶Let the Lord be praised. O you servants of the Lord, give praise to the name of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 135:2
segments: You who are in the house of the Lord, and in the open spaces of the house of our God,

entries.title: Psalms 135:3
segments: Give praise to Jah, for he is good: make melody to his name, for it is pleasing.

entries.title: Psalms 135:4
segments: For the Lord has taken Jacob for himself, and Israel for his property.

entries.title: Psalms 135:5
segments: ¶I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is greater than all other gods.

entries.title: Psalms 135:6
segments: The Lord has done whatever was pleasing to him, in heaven, and on the earth, in the seas and in all the deep waters.

entries.title: Psalms 135:7
segments: He makes the mists go up from the ends of the earth; he makes thunder-flames for the rain; he sends out the winds from his store-houses.

entries.title: Psalms 135:8
segments: He put to death the first-fruits of Egypt, of man and of beast.

entries.title: Psalms 135:9
segments: He sent signs and wonders among you, O Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

entries.title: Psalms 135:10
segments: He overcame great nations, and put strong kings to death;

entries.title: Psalms 135:11
segments: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;

entries.title: Psalms 135:12
segments: And gave their land for a heritage, even for a heritage to Israel his people.

entries.title: Psalms 135:13
segments: O Lord, your name is eternal; and the memory of you will have no end.

entries.title: Psalms 135:14
segments: For the Lord will be judge of his people's cause; his feelings will be changed to his servants.

entries.title: Psalms 135:15
segments: ¶The images of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

entries.title: Psalms 135:16
segments: They have mouths, but no voice, they have eyes, but they do not see;

entries.title: Psalms 135:17
segments: They have ears, but no hearing; and there is no breath in their mouths.

entries.title: Psalms 135:18
segments: Those who make them are like them; and so is everyone who puts his hope in them.

entries.title: Psalms 135:19
segments: Give praise to the Lord, O children of Israel: give praise to the Lord, O sons of Aaron:

entries.title: Psalms 135:20
segments: Give praise to the Lord, O sons of Levi: let all the worshippers of the Lord give him praise.

entries.title: Psalms 135:21
segments: Praise be to the Lord out of Zion, even to the Lord whose house is in Jerusalem, Let the Lord be praised.
